profile_policy: new empty user-data directory for every run
navigation_policy: prompt provides only the start URL; target must be reached by a recorded visible-link click
validation: deterministic URL, live DOM, answer, and action-history checks
cost_cap_policy: No new run starts after cumulative reported cost reaches the cap; a final in-flight run may cross it. No further paid work starts after a run with unreported cost.

Open Hacker News, follow the visible new/newest navigation link, and extract the first story title.

claim_boundary: Public, read-only micro-tasks only; results are not an official Browser-Use Benchmark score and do not measure general web-agent capability.
